usedFor: Sales events in noCRM.io, such as “Lead Won”, update a row in Google Sheets with “Update Spreadsheet Row”.

bestTemplate.name: “Lead Won” in noCRM.io, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: A lead turning Won is worth logging, and the action updates columns in a chosen sheet row.

watchOut: Other triggers like “Task Standby” can also feed “Update Spreadsheet Row”, so pick the one that matches your column.
